get_company_name_fuzzy_match: use FinanceKG to fuzzy match a query string against company names and return top matches
get_ticker_by_name: use FinanceKG to look up a stock ticker symbol by its company name
get_price_history: use FinanceKG to retrieve one year of daily OHLCV price history for a ticker
get_market_capitalization: use FinanceKG to retrieve the market capitalization value for a given ticker symbol
get_pe_ratio: use FinanceKG to retrieve the forward price-to-earnings ratio for a given ticker symbol
